summary: Postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote archive from Dropbox with Discord beacon
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle runs scripts/install.js, which downloads a ZIP archive from https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/djz38wdi1wks9j1h57zuv/coeur.zip into os.tmpdir(), extracts it (Expand-Archive on Windows, unzip on POSIX), and executes any.exe or.sh contained in the archive. The script early-returns when NODE_ENV=production or CI is set, so execution is targeted at developer workstations while evading CI-based analysis. Progress of each stage is POSTed to a hardcoded Discord webhook at discord.com/api/webhooks/1542235719144177775/..., providing per-host install-time telemetry to a non-first-party endpoint. The package's advertised purpose is string-case/obfuscation utilities, which does not require fetching or executing remote binaries.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
